scope: Transcribed source candidates only; bell_kernel.py contains no species defaults or registry.

primary.authors: K. L. Bell, H. B. Gilbody, J. G. Hughes, A. E. Kingston, F. J. Smith
primary.journal: Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data 12, 891–916
primary.table: Table 5, printed p.910, PDF page index20
primary.equation: sigma(E)=[A ln(E/I)+sum_{j=1}^5 B_j (1-I/E)^j]/(I E), E>I; sigma=0 for E<=I

provenance.acquisition: Primary-PDF text extracted through Exa, web, and Parallel Search; not original PDF bytes.
provenance.screenshot_limitation: Web screenshot returned text-only ImageDisplayed references; no image payload was available.
provenance.independent_extraction_caveat: Multiple extractors may share the same OCR; agreement is not independent page-pixel verification.

notes: Original NIST PDF text reads B1=-0.0186.
Haque et al.2006 DOI10.1103/PhysRevA.73.012708 transcribes B1=-0.00186.
The later paper agrees on B3=-0.1901, B4=0.9527, B5=0; primary OCR B3 sign is degraded.
Do not turn the original OCR preference into a claim of visual verification.
No default registration or physical low-temperature admission issued.
Original source assessment points to Montague et al. cross-section measurements and high-energy Born matching.

candidate_rows.source_reliability_sign_glyph: Exa/Parallel OCR reads +10; no page-pixel verification.
notes: Original source follows Zapesochnyi and Aleksakhin to about30eV and Jalin et al. at high energy.
This is not a state-resolved inner-shell or radiative branching contract.

domain.cross_section_form: Thresholded analytic representation for positive incident excess energy; low-temperature use is a declared model calculation.
domain.original_thermal_polynomial_fit: I/10 < kBT < 10 I for Eq6; do not extrapolate its polynomial below that range.
domain.near_threshold_uncertainty: Original authors qualify nominal 67%-confidence estimates near threshold, where uncertainty is greater.

isotopes.reason: No D/T/He3/Li6 isotope-specific threshold or cross-section correction is inherited. D-H43kB chemical offset requires an explicit kinetic/chemical adapter.

licensing.code_copying: None. Generic equations were independently implemented.
licensing.original_article: AIP/ACS article copyright is retained; this file records numeric facts and citations, not a reprinted article.
licensing.nist_hosting: NIST hosting is not an assumption that the entire article or third-party implementation is public domain.
